title: Setup wizard
failed: Setup failed; review the candidate and retry.
passwordPolicy: Enter the current password and a different, non-empty new password.
pppoeHelp: Choose a physical WAN port reserved for PPPoE. Enter the ISP username and an existing password/<name> secret reference. Setup creates the logical setup-pppoe WAN for the PPPoE connection; the password itself is never entered here.
defaultsHelp: Setup updates the selected WAN, hostname, time and administrator password. Existing LAN, DHCP, NAT, firewall and management settings are preserved.
summaryHelp: No changes have been applied. Review the exact diff before the single confirmed commit. Password values are redacted.
rerunWarning: I understand that rerunning setup overwrites the touched sections.
confirmHelp: Check management access and confirm before {{deadline}}; otherwise the configuration reverts.
selectInterface: Select a network interface before continuing.
interfacesFailed: Some network interfaces could not be loaded. Configured interfaces remain available.
noInterfaces: No dataplane interfaces are available. Check interface ownership and the agent connection, then retry.
pppoeRequired: Enter the ISP username and a valid password/<name> secret reference.
wanDetected: WAN settings are loaded from the current system when available. You can edit them before continuing.
wanManual: No unique WAN could be detected. Select an interface and review its connection settings.
routesFailed: Live routes could not be loaded. Review the gateway using the configured settings.
